    The facts about S₋ for the covering construction #

    For covering data, the two facts about S₋ used in Theorem 5.2 hold automatically, so covering data alone give the data of Theorem 5.2.

    • F₂(S₋) = π_*L(S₋) is indecomposable: L(S₋) is a brick, and for each class γ ≠ 1 of block positions some vertex x of the support of L(S₋) has γ x outside the support (the argument of Proposition 4.5 for L(S₋)), so PdData.isIndecomposable_of_brick applies.
    • F₂(S₋) ≇ F₂(T) for T ∈ C_fin: by exactness, dim L(T)(x) is dim L(0, W)(x) + dim L(V, 0)(x), and S₋, S₊ are retracts of (0, W), (V, 0) when W, V are nonzero; so a nonzero T ∈ C has dim F₂(T) ≥ dim L(S₊) + dim L(S₋) > dim F₂(S₋).
